# The fluid of every block state and how buckets and fluids treat it, as both official servers decide it (harness 0.21.0
# shape report): its fluid state (type and amount, or -), 1 when it takes poured water, and 1 when water and lava
# replace it (they replace the same states; nothing takes poured lava). Each block's rows give only the properties
# that decide them.
